verdict.rationale: Official TypeScript and Python SDKs are documented (npm install supermemory / pip install supermemory) wrapping a documented API, with extensive code examples (client.add, client.search) across docs, plus an API reference overview. This is corroborated by an official skill/CLI setup flow for agentic integration. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer confirmation of SDK reliability and a discoverable OpenAPI spec (probe found 404s on openapi.json paths).
